quest.title: Shadow Over Mondstadt
quest.description: Thanks to your efforts, Mondstadt's elemental flow has returned to normal. It's time to report back to Jean.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x225, Mora x4875, Character EXP x2550, Fine Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Listen to Jean's conversation with the strange person

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Isn't that Jean?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems she's talking to someone...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's let her finish, then go say hi?

dialogues.speaker: Anastasia
dialogues.text: ...which is what has brought us to this point in the first place.

dialogues.speaker: Anastasia
dialogues.text: If you are unable to promptly deal with the Stormterror threat, then leave the defense of Mondstadt to the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Anastasia
dialogues.text: We can put an end to Mondstadt's dragon issues. All we need to do is bring that monster to the—

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: "Monster"?

dialogues.speaker: Anastasia
dialogues.text: Yes. What's your point?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Ah...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I'd expect a more professional attitude from your diplomats.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Yet here you are saying you want to "put an end" to one of The Four Winds of Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I won't have any of this nonsense in front of the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Anastasia
dialogues.text: Heh... Hehehe... It's not as crazy as you make it sound.

dialogues.speaker: Anastasia
dialogues.text: Fine. That's enough negotiation for today.

dialogues.speaker: Anastasia
dialogues.text: At this stage it's simply... an amicable exchange of constructive opinions, no?

dialogues.speaker: Anastasia
dialogues.text: I'll be sure to make... thorough notes...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME}, you're back.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help. The elemental flow is finally stable.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: The aftermath of Stormterror's last attack is finally settled for the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: However, the pressure from the delegation has become too big to be ignored...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Delegation?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: From Liyue Harbor or Inazuma City?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Snezhnaya. They choose to follow the God of Cryo.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Their envoys go by a particular name: The Fatui. Heard of them?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, them. They are super famous.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, infamous is more the word...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I don't think killing Stormterror is the right course of action.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: The Cryo God's Fatui have always coveted the Anemo God's power.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I don't believe they have Mondstadt's best interests at heart.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Speaking of power...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: #What is it, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's something I need to show the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Oh? Let us head back to headquarters then.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: We shouldn't discuss important matters... out in the open.

talks.objective: Return to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters with Jean

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It's a crystal embedded with some kind of power... Lisa, are you able to analyze it?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Let me take a look...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hmm... I can see impurities in the crystal, but upon further inspection...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: No, I'm sorry, I can't make a proper analysis at the moment. Give me some time. I'll take a look through the library's restricted section.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Right. I'll leave the research to you then, Lisa.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Understood. I'll notify you all if I make any progress.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Though I wouldn't go getting your hopes up. They are incredibly ancient texts, not to mentio— Ouch!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Gosh, that hurt!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: The impurities in the crystal... It hurts when I get close...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I see... It appears to react to Visions.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: The impurities and the elemental energy we embody repel each other.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: #It's strange, though. {NICKNAME} has elemental abilities as well, but doesn't seem to be affected in the same way.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Anyway, the crystal would be better left in the hands of my cutie. It will just be a pain if left with us — both literally and metaphorically.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Do you know anything about what makes you special?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I do not know what to make of it either.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: #Well, then, {NICKNAME}... The Knights of Favonius have another favor to ask of you.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Please accept the title of Honorary Knight... and the gratitude of the Acting Grand Master.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: We ask for your continued assistance in finding some answers.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Stormterror's rage... and strange crystals... I know Mondstadt's peace hangs in the balance.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: May the wind open your eyes to the truth.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: We'll meet back here if you find anything.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Mondstadt and Snezhnaya are considered the same in status.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Mondstadt is independent, and does not belong to any other nation.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: In fact, despite being referred to as a city, Mondstadt is a nation.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Though, Snezhnaya's Fatui are known to be the most aggressive diplomats in Teyvat...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Makes sense, given the tone of that woman just now — so rude!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Okay then. You just need to follow the <color=#00E1FFFF>marked route</color> to the finish.
